from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

PROD = Path.home() / 'prediction_research_prod'
ROOT = Path.cwd()
VENV = PROD / '.venv/bin/python'
INTENDED = [
    'control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py',
    'tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py',
    'tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py',
    'knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json',
]
DEMO = 'control/dev_checks/project_executor_demo_e001.py'
HEX64 = re.compile(r'^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$')

def run(argv, *, cwd=ROOT, timeout=120, env=None):
    cp = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], cwd=cwd, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout, env=env)
    print('RUN', ' '.join(str(x) for x in argv), 'RC', cp.returncode)
    print(cp.stdout[-12000:])
    return cp

def git_prod(*args):
    return run(['git', *args], cwd=PROD, timeout=60)

def git_root(*args):
    return run(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, timeout=120)

def copy_tree_rel(rel):
    src = PROD / rel
    dst = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        print('SYNC_SKIP_MISSING', rel)
        return
    if src.is_file():
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
        return
    for p in src.rglob('*'):
        if not p.is_file():
            continue
        r = p.relative_to(PROD)
        if '__pycache__' in r.parts or p.suffix in {'.pyc', '.pyo'}:
            continue
        if str(r) == DEMO:
            continue
        q = ROOT / r
        q.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(p, q)

def sha256(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

print('GENERIC_AUTOBUILD_PINFIX_E005_BEGIN')
assert PROD.is_dir(), 'PROD_MISSING'
assert VENV.is_file(), 'VENV_MISSING'

before_cp = git_prod('diff', '--cached', '--name-status')
assert before_cp.returncode == 0, 'PROD_CACHED_STATUS_FAILED'
before_cached = before_cp.stdout
assert DEMO in before_cached, 'EXPECTED_STAGED_DEMO_NOT_PRESENT'
print('PROD_STAGED_PRESERVED_PRE=1')

for rel in ['control/codex_supervisor', 'tests/control', 'tests/codex_supervisor']:
    copy_tree_rel(rel)

planner = ROOT / INTENDED[0]
nonbuild_test = ROOT / INTENDED[1]
retry_test = ROOT / INTENDED[2]
config = ROOT / INTENDED[3]
assert planner.is_file(), 'PLANNER_MISSING_AFTER_SYNC'
assert nonbuild_test.is_file(), 'NONBUILDABLE_TEST_MISSING_AFTER_SYNC'
assert retry_test.is_file(), 'RETRY_TEST_MISSING_AFTER_SYNC'
assert config.is_file(), 'WORKTREE_CONFIG_MISSING'

planner_text = planner.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for marker in [
    'For REQUIRES_SHARED_INFRA or INSUFFICIENT_SPEC, components MUST be an empty list []',
    'NONBUILDABLE_COMPONENTS_MUST_BE_EMPTY',
    'BUILD_PLANNER_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED',
    'BUILD_PLANNER_COMPLETE_WITHOUT_STATE_ADVANCE',
]:
    assert marker in planner_text, 'PLANNER_MARKER_MISSING:' + marker
new_sha = sha256(planner)
print('PLANNER_SHA256=' + new_sha)

raw = config.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
obj = json.loads(raw)
candidates = []
def walk(v, path=()):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        for k, x in v.items():
            ks = str(k)
            if isinstance(x, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(x) and 'build_planner' in ks.lower():
                candidates.append((path + (ks,), x))
        mentions = [str(x) for x in v.values() if isinstance(x, str) and 'build_planner.py' in x.lower()]
        if mentions:
            for k, x in v.items():
                if isinstance(x, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(x) and str(k).lower() in {'sha256','source_sha256','hash','digest'}:
                    candidates.append((path + (str(k),), x))
        for k, x in v.items():
            walk(x, path + (str(k),))
    elif isinstance(v, list):
        for i, x in enumerate(v): walk(x, path + (f'[{i}]',))
walk(obj)
unique=[]; seen=set()
for item in candidates:
    if item[0] not in seen:
        seen.add(item[0]); unique.append(item)
assert len(unique) == 1, 'AMBIGUOUS_BUILD_PLANNER_PIN_COUNT:' + str(len(unique))
pin_path, old_sha = unique[0]
assert old_sha != new_sha, 'PIN_ALREADY_CURRENT_UNEXPECTED'
assert raw.count(old_sha) == 1, 'PIN_OLD_SHA_NOT_UNIQUE_IN_CONFIG'
config.write_text(raw.replace(old_sha, new_sha, 1), encoding='utf-8')
print('PIN_PATH=' + '.'.join(pin_path))
print('PIN_UPDATED=1')

targeted=[]
for p in sorted((ROOT/'tests/control').glob('test_*.py')):
    n=p.name.lower()
    if 'build_planner' in n or 'handoff' in n: targeted.append(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)))
for required in INTENDED[1:3]: assert required in targeted, 'TARGETED_TEST_NOT_DISCOVERED:' + required
assert targeted, 'NO_TARGETED_TESTS'
env=os.environ.copy(); env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
cp=run([VENV,'-m','pytest','-q',*targeted],cwd=ROOT,timeout=300,env=env)
assert cp.returncode==0,'TARGETED_TESTS_FAILED'
print('TARGETED_TESTS_PASS=1')

runtime_test=ROOT/'tests/codex_supervisor/test_autobuild_runtime_wiring_e004i.py'
assert runtime_test.is_file(),'RUNTIME_WIRING_TEST_MISSING'
cp=run([VENV,'-m','pytest','-q',str(runtime_test.relative_to(ROOT))],cwd=ROOT,timeout=300,env=env)
assert cp.returncode==0,'RUNTIME_WIRING_TESTS_FAILED'
print('RUNTIME_WIRING_TESTS_PASS=1')

cp=run([VENV,'-m','pytest','-q','tests'],cwd=ROOT,timeout=850,env=env)
assert cp.returncode==0,'FULL_TEST_SUITE_FAILED'
print('FULL_TEST_SUITE_PASS=1')
cp=git_root('diff','--check','--',*INTENDED); assert cp.returncode==0,'GIT_DIFF_CHECK_FAILED'
print('GIT_DIFF_CHECK_PASS=1')
cp=git_root('add','--',*INTENDED); assert cp.returncode==0,'GIT_ADD_FAILED'
cp=git_root('diff','--cached','--name-only'); assert cp.returncode==0,'GIT_CACHED_LIST_FAILED'
staged=[x.strip() for x in cp.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
assert set(staged)==set(INTENDED) and len(staged)==len(INTENDED),'UNEXPECTED_STAGED_SET:'+repr(staged)
print('STAGED_SET_EXACT=1')
cp=git_root('commit','-m','fix: make generic autobuild planner retry pin-consistent'); assert cp.returncode==0,'LOCAL_COMMIT_FAILED'
cp=git_root('rev-parse','HEAD'); assert cp.returncode==0,'LOCAL_COMMIT_HEAD_FAILED'
commit=cp.stdout.strip(); assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}',commit),'BAD_LOCAL_COMMIT_SHA'
print('LOCAL_COMMIT='+commit)
after_cp=git_prod('diff','--cached','--name-status'); assert after_cp.returncode==0,'PROD_CACHED_STATUS_POST_FAILED'
assert after_cp.stdout==before_cached,'PRODUCTION_INDEX_CHANGED'
assert DEMO in after_cp.stdout,'STAGED_DEMO_CHANGED_OR_REMOVED'
print('PROD_STAGED_PRESERVED_POST=1')
print('NO_PROVEN_EDGE=UNCHANGED')
print('GENERIC_AUTOBUILD_PINFIX_E005_PASS')

notes: Retry of E003 with the exact ProjectExecutor per-python maximum timeout. Isolated worktree only; update unique build_planner pin, run targeted/runtime/full tests, diff check, exact staged set and local commit while asserting production index remains unchanged.
